note: Single source of truth for the public Skills Library repository. scripts/sync-skills.mjs pulls from it, scripts/validate.mjs asserts the synced snapshot came from it, and scripts/skills-release-gate.mjs looks for its commit link on the live page. Migrating the library to a different repository is an edit to this file plus one sync run. SKILLS_REPOSITORY_OWNER and SKILLS_REPOSITORY_NAME still override at runtime for testing against a fork.
